description: Reshapes a phasor, warping where in its cycle it runs fast and where it runs slow; ten shaping algorithms, for sequence warping or phase distortion synthesis

params.text: Sets the depth of the shaping, negative one way and positive the other, with the phasor passed through unchanged at centre
Attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the Shape CV input before it is added to the Shape knob
Picks the shaping algorithm: Curve, S-Curve, Split, Swing, Shift, Triangle, Arc, Speed - Clip, Speed - Wrap and Speed - Fold; a lamp beside the list marks the one in use
Attenuverter scaling the Mode CV input, which steps through all ten algorithms across 5V

inputs.text: The phasor being shaped, 0-10V; voltages outside that range wrap back into it
Modulates the shaping depth, added to the Shape knob and clamped to the knob's own range
Modulates which shaping algorithm is used, added to the Mode knob

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
